page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u2i-c1m4.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by 32 dedicated Intel Xeon vCPUs built on the x86_64 architecture operating at a base frequency of 2.7 GHz. Accompanied by 128 GB of system memory, the instance delivers a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per core, characteristic of balanced general-purpose infrastructure.

The instance provides a baseline network throughput of 16 Gbps to support inter-service communication and remote I/O operations. It does not include bundled local storage or integrated hardware accelerators, requiring all persistent storage to be provisioned via external cloud block storage volumes. Furthermore, the instance provides zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses, necessitating configured Elastic IPs or NAT gateways for external public traffic.

Given its balanced resource profile, high dedicated core allocation, and substantial memory capacity, the ecs.u2i-c1m4.8xlarge fits production application backends, container orchestration nodes, relational database deployments, continuous integration systems, and distributed enterprise workloads.
